purpose: test whether PaliGemma layer 13 encodes layout-specific instruction-selected target geometry after removing the exact-prompt mean

source_design.correction_reason: v1 used BDDL region centers as a fixed-state validity surrogate and stopped at record 14 when an official saved state differed by more than 3 cm
source_design.model_record_use: not inspected statistically, not fitted, and not reused in v2

hypotheses.null: after conditioning on the exact ordered prompt pair, PaliGemma layer-13 activation differences do not predict held-out layout-specific target displacement and a decoder-derived patch does not redirect target choice beyond matched random control
hypotheses.alternative: PaliGemma layer-13 activation differences contain held-out layout-specific target displacement information and that information is causally usable to redirect target choice

site.selection_rule: fixed before TC2 from Action Atlas goal-discrimination localization and the parent full-replay manipulation

population.invalid_state_exclusion_rule: before v2 model output, exclude any fixed state where either instruction-selected subject has absolute workspace XY above 0.5 m or Z below 0.85 m after the frozen ten-step settling sequence
population.statistical_unit: one official LIBERO-Plus BDDL task and its physically valid fixed initial state
population.estimand_scope: the finite frozen set of physically valid visible LIBERO-Plus Spatial target-displacement states; layouts are nested within nine task families

stimulus.task_a: verbatim official LIBERO-Spatial prompt selecting akita_black_bowl_1
stimulus.task_b: verbatim official LIBERO-Spatial prompt describing the true initial relation of akita_black_bowl_2
stimulus.target: simulator-measured task_a minus task_b initial XY in the exact settled state shown to the model
stimulus.bddl_geometry_role: provenance and candidate enumeration only; BDDL region centers are not labels or validity targets
stimulus.construction_boundary: derived matched-prompt assay over unmodified official LIBERO-Plus BDDL and init-state assets; it is not an unmodified leaderboard task

observer.feature: task_a minus task_b full PaliGemma layer-13 residual grid
observer.target: task_a minus task_b simulator-measured initial target XY
observer.residualization: subtract observer-fit exact-prompt-family means from both feature and target; apply the fit means unchanged to validation
observer.fit: zero-intercept dual ridge on residualized features and targets
observer.ridge_scale: fraction of mean diagonal of the training Gram matrix
observer.selection: maximum leave-one-level-out R-squared on observer-fit residuals with prompt-family means re-estimated inside every fold; ties select the larger ridge fraction
baselines: first clean action-chunk difference as a positive control
observer.failure_action: stop before causal rollouts and do not create a controller

controller.desired_change: simulator-measured task_a minus task_b initial XY with zero Z component

causal_decision_rule.multiplicity: intersection-union; every frozen criterion must pass
causal_decision_rule.claim_boundary: exploratory causal pilot without an independent replication split

power_boundary: nine independent task-family clusters and 38 validation layouts target only large layout-specific information and redirection effects; failure does not exclude small or family-specific effects
claim_boundary: tests visible instruction-selected pickup-target XY geometry and its causal usability at one fixed PaliGemma layer in pi0.5-LIBERO; it does not establish temporally extended planning or a general world model
